```{r metric-helpers}
compute_f1 <- function(y_true, proba_class1) {
  y_pred <- ifelse(proba_class1 >= 0.5, 1, 0)
  tp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_true == 1)
  fp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_true == 0)
  fn <- sum(y_pred == 0 & y_true == 1)
  prec <- tp / max(tp + fp, 1)
  rec <- tp / max(tp + fn, 1)
  ifelse(prec + rec == 0, 0, 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec))
}

compute_auroc <- function(y_true, proba_class1) {
  n_pos <- sum(y_true == 1)
  n_neg <- sum(y_true == 0)
  if (n_pos == 0 || n_neg == 0) return(NA_real_)
  ord <- order(proba_class1, decreasing = TRUE)
  y_sorted <- y_true[ord]
  tp <- cumsum(y_sorted == 1)
  fp <- cumsum(y_sorted == 0)
  tpr <- tp / n_pos
  fpr <- fp / n_neg
  tpr <- c(0, tpr)
  fpr <- c(0, fpr)
  sum(diff(fpr) * (tpr[-1] + tpr[-length(tpr)]) / 2)
}

compute_auprc <- function(y_true, proba_class1) {
  n_pos <- sum(y_true == 1)
  if (n_pos == 0 || n_pos == length(y_true)) return(NA_real_)
  ord <- order(proba_class1, decreasing = TRUE)
  y_sorted <- y_true[ord]
  tp <- cumsum(y_sorted == 1)
  fp <- cumsum(y_sorted == 0)
  prec <- tp / (tp + fp)
  rec <- tp / n_pos
  rec <- c(0, rec)
  prec <- c(1, prec)
  sum(diff(rec) * (prec[-1] + prec[-length(prec)]) / 2)
}

metrics_list <- list(
  list(name = "F1",    fn = compute_f1,    unit = "pp"),
  list(name = "AUROC", fn = compute_auroc, unit = "pp"),
  list(name = "AUPRC", fn = compute_auprc, unit = "pp")
)
```

```{r delta-per-perturbation, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
perturbations <- df %>%
  filter(perturbation != "baseline", !is.na(perturbation)) %>%
  pull(perturbation) %>%
  unique()

for (metric in metrics_list) {

  # Baseline metric per model × dataset × fold
  metric_baseline <- df %>%
    filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
    distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model, fold) %>%
    summarise(val_baseline = metric$fn(y_true, proba_class1), .groups = "drop")

  for (selected_perturbation in perturbations) {

    # Perturbed metric per model × dataset × param_value × fold
    metric_pert <- df %>%
      filter(perturbation == selected_perturbation) %>%
      mutate(param_numeric = as.numeric(str_extract(param_value, "[\\d.]+"))) %>%
      filter(!is.na(param_numeric)) %>%
      group_by(dataset, model, param_value = param_numeric, fold) %>%
      summarise(val_pert = metric$fn(y_true, proba_class1), .groups = "drop")

    # Delta = perturbed - baseline (pp), then summarise
    df_delta <- metric_pert %>%
      left_join(metric_baseline, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(val_baseline), !is.na(val_pert)) %>%
      mutate(delta = (val_pert - val_baseline) * 100) %>%
      group_by(dataset, model, param_value) %>%
      summarise(
        delta_mean = mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE),
        delta_se = sd(delta, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(delta))),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    # Add zero-point (no perturbation) so lines start at origin
    df_zero <- df_delta %>%
      distinct(dataset, model) %>%
      mutate(param_value = 0, delta_mean = 0, delta_se = 0)
    df_delta <- bind_rows(df_zero, df_delta)

    # Convert param_value to ordered factor for evenly spaced x-axis
    param_levels <- sort(unique(df_delta$param_value))
    df_delta <- df_delta %>%
      mutate(param_value = factor(param_value, levels = param_levels))

    p <- ggplot(df_delta, aes(x = param_value, y = delta_mean, color = model, group = model)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = delta_mean - delta_se, ymax = delta_mean + delta_se),
                    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4,
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.15)) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.15)) +
      facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_x") +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-100, 100, by = 10),
                         labels = function(x) paste0(x, " ", metric$unit)) +
      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Model") +
      labs(
        x = "Parameter value",
        y = bquote(Delta*.(metric$name) ~ "(pp, perturbed - baseline, mean" %+-% "SE across folds)"),
        title = paste0(metric$name, " degradation from baseline (", selected_perturbation, ")")
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.direction = "horizontal",
            plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"),
            legend.text = element_text(size=12),
            legend.title = element_text(size=14),
            legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
            legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
            legend.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
            axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))) +
      guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4), nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

    ggsave(file.path(plots_path, paste0("delta_", tolower(metric$name), "_", selected_perturbation, ".pdf")),
           plot = p, width = 10, height = 8)
  }
}
```

```{r calibration-curves, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Deduplicate baseline (appears once per perturbation)
df_cal <- df %>%
  filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
  distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Bin predictions and compute observed frequency
df_cal_binned <- df_cal %>%
  mutate(bin = cut(proba_class1, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
                   include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, model, bin) %>%
  summarise(
    observed = mean(y_true),
    predicted = mean(proba_class1),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bin))

p_cal <- ggplot(df_cal_binned, aes(x = predicted, y = observed, color = model)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  #geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Model") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "N samples", range = c(1, 5)) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean predicted probability",
    y = "Observed frequency (class 1)",
    title = "Calibration curves (baseline predictions)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file.path(plots_path, "calibration_curves.pdf"),
       plot = p_cal, width = 12, height = 8)
```

```{r ranking-stability, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Use metrics_all.csv: compute mean AUROC per model × dataset × perturbation × param_value
# Include baseline level (from baseline_auroc column)
for (selected_perturbation in unique(metrics_df$perturbation)) {

  # Baseline ranks (one row per model × dataset, averaged over folds)
  df_bl_rank <- metrics_df %>%
    filter(perturbation == selected_perturbation) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model) %>%
    summarise(mean_auroc = mean(baseline_auroc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(param_value = "baseline")

  # Perturbed ranks per param_value
  df_pert_rank <- metrics_df %>%
    filter(perturbation == selected_perturbation) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model, param_value) %>%
    summarise(mean_auroc = mean(auroc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Combine and rank
  df_ranks <- bind_rows(df_bl_rank, df_pert_rank) %>%
    group_by(dataset, param_value) %>%
    mutate(rank = rank(-mean_auroc, ties.method = "average")) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Order param_value: baseline first, then sorted numerically
  param_levels <- df_ranks %>%
    distinct(param_value) %>%
    mutate(num = as.numeric(str_extract(param_value, "[\\d.]+"))) %>%
    arrange(is.na(num), num) %>%
    pull(param_value)
  df_ranks <- df_ranks %>%
    mutate(param_value = factor(param_value, levels = param_levels))

  p_rank <- ggplot(df_ranks, aes(x = param_value, y = rank, color = model, group = model)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:6) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Model") +
    labs(
      x = "Perturbation level",
      y = "AUROC rank (1 = best)",
      title = paste0("Model ranking stability (", selected_perturbation, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  ggsave(file.path(plots_path, paste0("ranking_stability_", selected_perturbation, ".pdf")),
         plot = p_rank, width = 12, height = 8)
}
```

```{r sample-prediction-shift, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
for (selected_perturbation in perturbations) {

  # Baseline probabilities per sample (deduplicated)
  df_bl_proba <- df %>%
    filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
    distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, proba_bl = proba_class1)

  # Perturbed probabilities
  df_pert_proba <- df %>%
    filter(perturbation == selected_perturbation, param_value != "baseline") %>%
    mutate(param_numeric = as.numeric(str_extract(param_value, "[\\d.]+"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(param_numeric))

  # Mean absolute shift per model × dataset × param_value (averaged over samples and folds)
  df_shift <- df_pert_proba %>%
    left_join(df_bl_proba, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold", "sample_idx")) %>%
    mutate(abs_delta = abs(proba_class1 - proba_bl)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model, param_numeric) %>%
    summarise(mean_abs_shift = mean(abs_delta, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  p_shift <- ggplot(df_shift,
                    aes(x = factor(round(param_numeric, 3)),
                        y = model,
                        fill = mean_abs_shift)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Mean |shift|", option = "inferno", direction = -1) +
    labs(
      x = "Perturbation level",
      y = "Model",
      title = paste0("Mean absolute prediction shift (", selected_perturbation, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom")

  ggsave(file.path(plots_path, paste0("prediction_shift_", selected_perturbation, ".pdf")),
         plot = p_shift, width = 12, height = 6)
}
```

```{r robustness-vs-baseline, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

  group_by(dataset, model) %>%
  summarise(
```

```{r model-agreement, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Baseline predictions pivoted wide: one column per model
df_wide <- df %>%
  filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
  distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(dataset, fold, sample_idx, model, proba_class1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = proba_class1)

model_names <- sort(unique(df$model))
datasets_list <- unique(df_wide$dataset)

pdf(file.path(plots_path, "model_agreement.pdf"), width = 14, height = 8)
par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
for (ds in datasets_list) {
  mat <- df_wide %>%
    filter(dataset == ds) %>%
    select(all_of(model_names)) %>%
    cor(method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  corrplot(mat, method = "color", type = "lower", addCoef.col = "black",
           number.cex = 0.8, tl.cex = 0.9, tl.col = "black",
           title = ds, mar = c(0, 0, 1.5, 0),
           cl.lim = c(-1, 1))
}
dev.off()
```

```{r prediction-flip-rate, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Fraction of samples whose predicted class flips (crosses 0.5) under perturbation vs baseline
df_bl_class <- df %>%
  filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
  distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pred_bl = ifelse(proba_class1 >= 0.5, 1, 0)) %>%
  select(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, pred_bl)

for (selected_perturbation in perturbations) {

  df_pert_class <- df %>%
    filter(perturbation == selected_perturbation, param_value != "baseline") %>%
    mutate(param_numeric = as.numeric(str_extract(param_value, "[\\d.]+")),
           pred_pert = ifelse(proba_class1 >= 0.5, 1, 0)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(param_numeric))

  df_flip <- df_pert_class %>%
    left_join(df_bl_class, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold", "sample_idx")) %>%
    mutate(flipped = pred_pert != pred_bl) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model, param_numeric) %>%
    summarise(flip_rate = mean(flipped, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Add zero-point (no perturbation, flip_rate = 0)
  df_zero <- df_flip %>%
    distinct(dataset, model) %>%
    mutate(param_numeric = 0, flip_rate = 0)
  df_flip <- bind_rows(df_zero, df_flip)

  # Convert to ordered factor for evenly spaced x-axis
  param_levels <- sort(unique(df_flip$param_numeric))
  df_flip <- df_flip %>%
    mutate(param_numeric = factor(param_numeric, levels = param_levels))

  p_flip <- ggplot(df_flip,
                   aes(x = param_numeric, y = flip_rate, color = model, group = model)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Model") +
    labs(
      x = "Perturbation level",
      y = "Flip rate",
      title = paste0("Prediction flip rate (", selected_perturbation, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4), nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

  ggsave(file.path(plots_path, paste0("flip_rate_", selected_perturbation, ".pdf")),
         plot = p_flip, width = 12, height = 6)
}
```

```{r shift-concordance, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Spearman correlation of per-sample prediction shifts between models
# Answers: do models fail on the same samples?
model_names <- sort(unique(df$model))

df_bl_proba <- df %>%
  filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
  distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, proba_bl = proba_class1)

for (selected_perturbation in perturbations) {

  # Compute per-sample shift (perturbed - baseline)
  df_shift_wide <- df %>%
    filter(perturbation == selected_perturbation, param_value != "baseline") %>%
    left_join(df_bl_proba, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold", "sample_idx")) %>%
    mutate(delta = proba_class1 - proba_bl) %>%
    select(dataset, fold, sample_idx, param_value, model, delta) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = delta)

  datasets_pert <- unique(df_shift_wide$dataset)

  pdf(file.path(plots_path,
                paste0("shift_concordance_", selected_perturbation, ".pdf")),
      width = 14, height = 8)
  par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))

  for (ds in datasets_pert) {
    sub <- df_shift_wide %>%
      filter(dataset == ds) %>%
      select(all_of(model_names))

    if (nrow(sub) < 3) next

    mat <- cor(sub, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    corrplot(mat, method = "color", type = "lower", addCoef.col = "black",
             number.cex = 0.8, tl.cex = 0.9, tl.col = "black",
             title = paste0(ds, " (", selected_perturbation, ")"),
             mar = c(0, 0, 1.5, 0),
             cl.lim = c(-1, 1))
  }

  dev.off()
}
```

```{r shift-concordance-boxplot, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
    filter(perturbation == selected_perturbation, param_value != "baseline") %>%
    left_join(df_bl_proba_bp, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold", "sample_idx")) %>%
    mutate(delta = proba_class1 - proba_bl) %>%
    select(dataset, fold, sample_idx, param_value, model, delta) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = delta)

  # Compute correlation per param_value so we get a distribution for boxplots
  for (ds in unique(df_shift_wide$dataset)) {
    for (pv in unique(df_shift_wide$param_value)) {
      sub <- df_shift_wide %>%
        filter(dataset == ds, param_value == pv) %>%
        select(all_of(model_names))

      if (nrow(sub) < 3) next

      mat <- cor(sub, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

      # Extract lower triangle pairs
      for (i in 2:ncol(mat)) {
        for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
          cor_records <- c(cor_records, list(tibble(
            perturbation = selected_perturbation,
            dataset = ds,
            param_value = pv,
            model_pair = paste0(colnames(mat)[j], " vs\n", colnames(mat)[i]),
            rho = mat[i, j]
          )))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

df_cor <- bind_rows(cor_records)

p_cor_box <- ggplot(df_cor, aes(x = model_pair, y = rho, fill = perturbation)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Perturbation") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Model pair",
    y = "Spearman correlation of per-sample prediction shifts",
    title = "Shift concordance across datasets (do models fail on the same samples?)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

ggsave(file.path(plots_path, "shift_concordance_boxplot.pdf"),
       plot = p_cor_box, width = 14, height = 8)

# One plot per dataset
for (ds in unique(df_cor$dataset)) {
  df_cor_ds <- df_cor %>% filter(dataset == ds)

  p_cor_box_ds <- ggplot(df_cor_ds, aes(x = model_pair, y = rho, fill = perturbation)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Perturbation") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(
      x = "Model pair",
      y = "Spearman correlation of per-sample prediction shifts",
      title = paste0("Shift concordance (", ds, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

  ggsave(file.path(plots_path, paste0("shift_concordance_boxplot_", ds, ".pdf")),
         plot = p_cor_box_ds, width = 14, height = 8)
}
```

```{r flip-asymmetry, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Class-conditional flip asymmetry: 1->0 vs 0->1 flips
df_bl_class <- df %>%
  filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
  distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pred_bl = ifelse(proba_class1 >= 0.5, 1, 0)) %>%
  select(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, pred_bl)

for (selected_perturbation in perturbations) {

  df_pert_class <- df %>%
    filter(perturbation == selected_perturbation, param_value != "baseline") %>%
    mutate(param_numeric = as.numeric(str_extract(param_value, "[\\d.]+")),
           pred_pert = ifelse(proba_class1 >= 0.5, 1, 0)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(param_numeric))

  df_asym <- df_pert_class %>%
    left_join(df_bl_class, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold", "sample_idx")) %>%
    filter(pred_pert != pred_bl) %>%
    mutate(direction = ifelse(pred_bl == 1 & pred_pert == 0, "1 \u2192 0", "0 \u2192 1")) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model, param_numeric, direction) %>%
    summarise(n_flips = n(), .groups = "drop")

  # Get total samples per group for rate calculation
  df_total <- df_pert_class %>%
    left_join(df_bl_class, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold", "sample_idx")) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model, param_numeric) %>%
    summarise(n_total = n(), .groups = "drop")

  df_asym <- df_asym %>%
    left_join(df_total, by = c("dataset", "model", "param_numeric")) %>%
    mutate(flip_rate = n_flips / n_total)

  # Add zero-point (no perturbation, flip_rate = 0) for both directions
  directions <- unique(df_asym$direction)
  df_zero <- expand.grid(
    dataset = unique(df_asym$dataset),
    model = unique(df_asym$model),
    direction = directions,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(param_numeric = 0, flip_rate = 0, n_flips = 0, n_total = NA)
  df_asym <- bind_rows(df_zero, df_asym)

  # Convert to ordered factor for evenly spaced x-axis
  param_levels <- sort(unique(df_asym$param_numeric))
  df_asym <- df_asym %>%
    mutate(param_numeric = factor(param_numeric, levels = param_levels))

  p_asym <- ggplot(df_asym,
                   aes(x = param_numeric, y = flip_rate,
                       color = model, linetype = direction,
                       group = interaction(model, direction))) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Model") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("1 \u2192 0" = "solid", "0 \u2192 1" = "dashed"),
                          name = "Flip direction") +
    labs(
      x = "Perturbation level",
      y = "Flip rate",
      title = paste0("Class-conditional flip asymmetry (", selected_perturbation, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4), nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
           linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  ggsave(file.path(plots_path, paste0("flip_asymmetry_", selected_perturbation, ".pdf")),
         plot = p_asym, width = 12, height = 8)
}
```

```{r robustness-audc, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Area Under the Degradation Curve (AUDC) — single robustness score per model × dataset × perturbation
metric_baseline <- df %>%
  filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
  distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(dataset, model, fold) %>%
  summarise(auroc_bl = compute_auroc(y_true, proba_class1), .groups = "drop")

audc_all <- list()

for (selected_perturbation in perturbations) {

  metric_pert <- df %>%
    filter(perturbation == selected_perturbation, param_value != "baseline") %>%
    mutate(param_numeric = as.numeric(str_extract(param_value, "[\\d.]+"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(param_numeric)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model, fold, param_numeric) %>%
    summarise(auroc_pert = compute_auroc(y_true, proba_class1), .groups = "drop")

  # Delta AUROC per fold, then mean across folds
  df_delta <- metric_pert %>%
    left_join(metric_baseline, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold")) %>%
    mutate(delta = (auroc_pert - auroc_bl) * 100) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model, param_numeric) %>%
    summarise(delta_mean = mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # AUDC: trapezoidal integration of delta curve over normalised perturbation levels
  df_audc <- df_delta %>%
    arrange(dataset, model, param_numeric) %>%
    group_by(dataset, model) %>%
    summarise(
      audc = {
        x <- param_numeric
        y <- delta_mean
        if (length(x) < 2) NA_real_
        else {
          x_norm <- (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
          sum(diff(x_norm) * (y[-length(y)] + y[-1]) / 2)
        }
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(perturbation = selected_perturbation)

  audc_all <- c(audc_all, list(df_audc))
}

df_audc_all <- bind_rows(audc_all)

p_audc <- ggplot(df_audc_all,
                 aes(x = model, y = audc, fill = perturbation)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Perturbation") +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = "AUDC (pp, lower = more degradation)",
    title = "Robustness summary: Area Under the Degradation Curve (AUROC)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(plots_path, "robustness_audc.pdf"),
       plot = p_audc, width = 12, height = 6)
```

# Final figures

## 1. AUROC Degradation

```{r auroc-degradation-boxplot, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Compact boxplot: delta AUROC across perturbation levels per model × dataset × perturbation
# One figure combining all 3 perturbation types

metric_fn <- compute_auroc

# Baseline AUROC per model × dataset × fold
auroc_baseline <- df %>%
  filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
  distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(dataset, model, fold) %>%
  summarise(val_baseline = metric_fn(y_true, proba_class1), .groups = "drop")

# Perturbed AUROC per model × dataset × perturbation × param_value × fold
auroc_pert <- df %>%
  filter(perturbation != "baseline", !is.na(perturbation), param_value != "baseline") %>%
  mutate(param_numeric = as.numeric(str_extract(param_value, "[\\d.]+"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(param_numeric)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, model, perturbation, param_numeric, fold) %>%
  summarise(val_pert = metric_fn(y_true, proba_class1), .groups = "drop")

# Delta AUROC (pp) per fold × perturbation level
df_delta_all <- auroc_pert %>%
  left_join(auroc_baseline, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(val_baseline), !is.na(val_pert)) %>%
  mutate(delta = (val_pert - val_baseline) * 100)

# Bar plot with error bars: mean ± SE of delta AUROC
df_delta_bar <- df_delta_all %>%
  group_by(dataset, model, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(
    delta_mean = mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_se = sd(delta, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(delta))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Sort models by overall mean delta (least degradation first)
model_order <- df_delta_bar %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(overall_mean = mean(delta_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(overall_mean)) %>%
  pull(model)
df_delta_bar <- df_delta_bar %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = model_order))

# Significance: flag model × dataset × perturbation where any param_value is significant
df_sig <- stats_df %>%
  mutate(significant = as.logical(significant) | tolower(as.character(significant)) == "true") %>%
  group_by(dataset, model, perturbation) %>%
  summarise(any_sig = any(significant, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_sig)

# Merge significance with bar data for asterisk placement
df_delta_bar <- df_delta_bar %>%
  left_join(df_sig, by = c("dataset", "model", "perturbation")) %>%
  mutate(any_sig = replace_na(any_sig, FALSE),
         label = ifelse(any_sig, "*", ""),
         model = factor(model, levels = model_order))

p_auroc_bar <- ggplot(df_delta_bar, aes(x = model, y = delta_mean, fill = perturbation)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = delta_mean - delta_se, ymax = delta_mean + delta_se),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(y = ifelse(delta_mean < 0, delta_mean - delta_se - 3, delta_mean + delta_se + 3),
                label = label),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), size = 4, color = "firebrick", vjust = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Perturbation") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-30, 30, by = 10), labels = function(x) paste0(x, " pp")) +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = expression(Delta * "AUROC (pp, mean" %+-% "SE)"),
    # title = "AUROC degradation under perturbation"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plots_path, "paper", "auroc_degradation_barplot.pdf"),
  plot = p_auroc_bar,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  scale = 0.6,
  limitsize = FALSE
)

ggsave(file.path(plots_path, "png", "auroc_degradation_barplot.png"),
       plot = p_auroc_bar, width = 14, height = 8, scale=0.8)
```

```{r flip-rate-grid, fig.width=18, fig.height=10}
# facet_grid(perturbation ~ dataset): lines showing flip rate progression
# All 3 perturbations × 6 datasets in one figure

df_bl_class_all <- df %>%
  filter(param_value == "baseline") %>%
  distinct(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pred_bl = ifelse(proba_class1 >= 0.5, 1, 0)) %>%
  select(dataset, model, fold, sample_idx, pred_bl)

df_pert_class_all <- df %>%
  filter(perturbation != "baseline", !is.na(perturbation), param_value != "baseline") %>%
  mutate(param_numeric = as.numeric(str_extract(param_value, "[\\d.]+")),
         pred_pert = ifelse(proba_class1 >= 0.5, 1, 0)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(param_numeric))

# Flip rate per model × dataset × perturbation × param_value
df_flip_all <- df_pert_class_all %>%
  left_join(df_bl_class_all, by = c("dataset", "model", "fold", "sample_idx")) %>%
  mutate(flipped = pred_pert != pred_bl) %>%
  group_by(dataset, model, perturbation, param_numeric) %>%
  summarise(flip_rate = mean(flipped, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Add zero-point (no perturbation, flip_rate = 0)
df_zero_all <- df_flip_all %>%
  distinct(dataset, model, perturbation) %>%
  mutate(param_numeric = 0, flip_rate = 0)
df_flip_all <- bind_rows(df_zero_all, df_flip_all)

# Convert to ordered factor per perturbation for evenly spaced x-axis
df_flip_all <- df_flip_all %>%
  group_by(perturbation) %>%
  mutate(param_factor = factor(param_numeric, levels = sort(unique(param_numeric)))) %>%
  ungroup()

p_flip_grid <- ggplot(df_flip_all,
                      aes(x = param_factor, y = flip_rate, color = model, group = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  facet_grid(dataset ~ perturbation, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Model") +
  labs(
    x = "Perturbation level",
    y = "Flip rate",
    title = "Prediction flip rate under perturbation"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4), nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

ggsave(file.path(plots_path, "flip_rate_grid.pdf"),
       plot = p_flip_grid, width = 10, height = 18, scale = 0.8)
```

```{r flip-rate-combined, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Per-dataset facets, color = model, linetype = perturbation
# Normalize x-axis to [0, 1] per perturbation so different scales are comparable

df_flip_norm <- df_flip_all %>%
  group_by(perturbation) %>%
  mutate(param_norm = (param_numeric - min(param_numeric)) /
           (max(param_numeric) - min(param_numeric))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(param_norm = replace_na(param_norm, 0))

p_flip_combined <- ggplot(df_flip_norm,
                          aes(x = param_norm, y = flip_rate,
                              color = model, linetype = perturbation,
                              group = interaction(model, perturbation))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Model") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Feature Removal" = "solid",
                                   "Zero Inflation" = "dashed",
                                   "Zero Imputation" = "dotted"),
                        name = "Perturbation") +
  labs(
    x = "Normalised perturbation intensity (0 = none, 1 = max)",
    y = "Flip rate",
    #title = "Prediction flip rate under perturbation"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4), nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
         linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plots_path, "paper", "flip_rate_combined.pdf"),
  plot = p_flip_combined,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  scale = 0.6,
  limitsize = FALSE
)

ggsave(file.path(plots_path, "png", "flip_rate_combined.png"),
       plot = p_flip_combined, width = 14, height = 10, scale = 0.8)
```

## 4. Shift concordance

```{r shift-concordance-heatmap, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Option A: Heatmap — mean rho per model pair × dataset, faceted by perturbation
# Clean model pair labels (remove newline used for boxplot x-axis)
df_cor_mean <- df_cor %>%
  mutate(model_pair = str_replace(model_pair, "\n", " ")) %>%
  group_by(perturbation, dataset, model_pair) %>%
  summarise(mean_rho = mean(rho, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_cor_heat <- ggplot(df_cor_mean, aes(x = dataset, y = model_pair, fill = mean_rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_rho)), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ perturbation, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1),
                       name = "Mean Spearman rho") +
  labs(
    x = "Dataset",
    y = "Model pair",
    title = "Pairwise shift concordance across datasets and perturbations"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(file.path(plots_path, "shift_concordance_heatmap.pdf"),
       plot = p_cor_heat, width = 14, height = 10)
```

```{r shift-concordance-dotplot, fig.width=18, fig.height=6}
# Violin + jittered points, ordered by median correlation, facets in single row
df_cor_violin <- df_cor %>%
  mutate(model_pair = str_replace(model_pair, "\n", " "))

# Order model pairs by median rho (strongest first)
pair_order <- df_cor_violin %>%
  group_by(model_pair) %>%
  summarise(med_rho = median(rho, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(med_rho)) %>%
  pull(model_pair)
df_cor_violin <- df_cor_violin %>%
  mutate(model_pair = factor(model_pair, levels = pair_order))

# Bold the whole label only for TFM vs TFM pairs (RF and XGBoost are baselines)
tfm_models <- c("ContextTab", "TabDPT", "TabICL", "TabPFN")
bold_tfm_labels <- function(x) {
  vapply(as.character(x), function(lbl) {
    parts <- str_split(lbl, " vs ")[[1]]
    if (all(parts %in% tfm_models)) paste0("**", lbl, "**") else lbl
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

p_cor_dot <- ggplot(df_cor_violin, aes(x = model_pair, y = rho)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_violin(color = "grey50", alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = dataset), width = 0.15, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(perturbation ~., ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Dataset") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = bold_tfm_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.5, 1, by = 0.25), limits = c(-0.5, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Prediction shift correlation",
    #title = "Pairwise shift concordance under perturbation"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.spacing.y = unit(-2, "pt"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(8, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(10, "pt"),
        legend.key.height = unit(10, "pt"),
        axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 3, override.aes = list(size = 3)))


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plots_path, "paper", "shift_concordance_dotplot.pdf"),
  plot = p_cor_dot,
  width = 11,
  height = 13,
  units = "in",
  scale = 0.7,
  limitsize = FALSE
)


ggsave(file.path(plots_path, "png", "shift_concordance_dotplot.png"),
       plot = p_cor_dot, width = 10, height = 12, scale=0.8)
```
